summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests navlimetostat (BMS-986504) alone and with other anti-cancer drugs in people with advanced or metastatic solid tumors that have MTAP deletion. The record does not state the route, dose amount, or how long or how often treatment is given; it only says the drugs are given at a specified dose on specified days. The study will assess safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, and preliminary anti-tumor activity.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa navlimetostat (BMS-986504) solo y con otros medicamentos contra el cáncer en personas con tumores sólidos avanzados o metastásicos que tienen deleción de MTAP. El registro no indica la vía, la dosis, ni con qué frecuencia o durante cuánto tiempo se administra el tratamiento; solo señala que los medicamentos se dan en una dosis específica en días específicos. El estudio evaluará la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, la farmacocinética, la farmacodinámica y la actividad antitumoral preliminar.
who_for: Advanced or metastatic solid tumor with homozygous MTAP deletion or MTAP loss in tumor tissue
Progression after prior therapy, or no prior systemic therapy, depending on the cohort
At least one measurable tumor lesion on RECIST v1.1 or mRECIST, and RANO 2.0 where applicable
INR and APTT at or below 1.5 times upper limit of normal (2 times if liver involvement)
not_for: Prior treatment with a PRMT5 or MAT2A inhibitor
Active brain metastases or carcinomatous meningitis (treated, stable brain metastases may be allowed)
Gastrointestinal conditions in the past 6 months that could affect absorption or swallowing pills
Inadequate organ function on screening lab tests
Active hepatitis B or hepatitis C
